original_submission.strongest_statement: Multiple original bat systems retain repeatable centered vertical-distribution identity after coarse horizontal occupancy and absolute vertical level are controlled.

external_replication_status.qualification: under the separately frozen four-individual small-panel programme; does not retroactively satisfy the earlier >=5-individual programme

positive_system_localization.synthesis: context-residual individuality where the centered vertical signal is present

multidimensional_synthesis.name: configurable spatial individuality
multidimensional_synthesis.statement: Bat systems occupy different configurations across horizontal location identity, absolute vertical level, centered vertical-distribution shape, temporal persistence, and within-context residual identity.

examples.Hipposideros: strong source-reported horizontal site fidelity + source-level centered vertical FAIL
examples.original positive panels: centered vertical identity beyond coarse horizontal occupancy

comparative_search_boundary.Leptonycteris nivalis: structural STOP before altitude; 0 >=50-fix repeat individuals
comparative_search_boundary.Desmodus rotundus: structural STOP before altitude; no admitted local panel
comparative_search_boundary.Airflows bat panels: 5 necessary-screen panels all structural STOP under >=50-fix-night rule
comparative_search_boundary.Myotis vivesi: structural STOP under >=5 programme; evaluated only under separate frozen n=4 programme
comparative_search_boundary.Pteropus poliocephalus: structural STOP under >=5 programme; evaluated only under separate frozen n=4 programme
comparative_search_boundary.multiple Movebank candidates: rejected for absent native event-level vertical field

strongest_general_statement: Centered vertical individuality is independently prospectively replicable but strongly heterogeneous across bat systems. Spatial individuality is multidimensional and its coupling across horizontal and vertical axes is system-dependent.
next_questions: what predicts calibrated centered vertical-individuality effect size across systems
what predicts coupling versus decoupling of horizontal and vertical individuality
what generates within-context vertical individuality where it exists

programme_status.future_progress: new independent systems under a predeclared heterogeneity-oriented comparative design
